newsitem.title: GREECE: COMMITTEE FOR NEW CONSERVATIVE MOVEMENT TO BE SET UP SOON.
newsitem.headline: COMMITTEE FOR NEW CONSERVATIVE MOVEMENT TO BE SET UP SOON.

text.p: The committee that will prepare the ground for a new Greek political conservative movement will be announced soon, former conservative industry minister Andreas Andrianopoulos told Reuters.

"The initiative team that will be the vehicle for the preparation of a new party will be announced in a few days," said Andrianopoulos. "The new movement will seek to express the exasperated middle class and fill a gap in the political spectrum."

The government has unleashed a tax raid on the middle class whose interests are not protected by the main opposition conservative New Democracy party, he added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
